missing: Three refutations. (1) Conflict resolution is wrong: merge_from_peer compares provenance as a string, so a stale write outranks a newer one — 'p9' beats 'p10' lexically and the replica keeps the older record forever (vc_201_084_mastery_lexical_provenance_keeps_stale_write). (2) Deletion does not propagate on the export/merge path: export_for_peers silently drops tombstoned records and merge_from_peer never sees the tombstone set, so a peer that only merges exports keeps deleted content and can re-broadcast it; only the converge() helper's separate tombstone sync carries deletes (vc_201_084_mastery_delete_does_not_propagate_via_export_merge). (3) No peer authentication exists in the path and memory_replicate has no production caller — no replication channel runs this code. Holds: converge() converges eligible records and tombstones, local_only records never export, tombstoned records never revive (vc_201_084_mastery_converge_and_eligibility_hold).
